It’s purely professional jealousy and office politics taken to a malicious extreme by the people right next to me in the organizational chart. So, no, definitely just them. I’ve kept my focus entirely on their specific digital footprints because I know that's where the truth is, even if IT refuses to look past the reconstructed logs.

Well, yes, absolutely. I mean, it's not even a question of if the technology exists, it's a question of how they're applying it. As I was saying earlier—and this is really the crux of why I'm here, because for months I’ve been seeing this exact same pattern in the project files—it's this specific colleague and his subcontractors making these tiny, deliberate changes to the translation memory and the timestamps.
